# Gladstone Land Corporation Earnings Call and Webcast Information


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f57aa13e2266330910240d0daea238d1/gladstonefarms/news/2026-08-10_Gladstone_Land_Corporation_Earnings_Call_and_371.pdf) August 10, 2026 8:30am EDT


**MCLEAN, VA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / August 10, 2026 /**[Gladstone Land Corporation](https://pr.report/nsa7) (Nasdaq:LAND) announces the following event:


What:


Gladstone Land Corporation's Second Quarter Ended June 30, 2026, Earnings Call & Webcast


When:


Wednesday, August 12, 2026 @ 8:30 a.m. ET


Where:


[https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=N1TIXnXt](https://pr.report/nsa8)


How:


By webcast -- Log on to the web at the address above


By phone -- Please call (877) 407-9046


Contact:


Gladstone Land Corporation, (703) 287-5893


A conference call replay will be available after the call and will be accessible through August 19, 2026. To hear the replay, please dial (877) 660-6853 and use playback conference number 13760773.


If you are unable to participate during the live webcast, the call will be archived and available for replay on the Company's website,[www.GladstoneLand.com](https://pr.report/nsa9) .


Gladstone Land Corporation is a real estate investment trust that specializes in purchasing farms and farm-related properties and leasing them to farmers. Additional information can be found at[www.gladstoneland.com](https://pr.report/nsaa) .


For further information: Gladstone Land Corporation, (703) 287-5893


**SOURCE:** Gladstone Land Corporation
